reason: Both plans satisfy all hard requirements equally well, but Response A's halt-condition metrics are more rigorous and actionable (four distinct thresholds each tied to a specific measurement window: 24h payment-failure rate, 24h discrepancy rate, 1h API error rate, and P95 latency degradation), and it pairs each phase with both an entry and an exit criterion, giving a tighter, more operationally complete gating mechanism than Response B's shorter halt-metrics list.
